preconditions.description: The input string s has a length between 1 and 10 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all('a' <= c <= 'z' for c in s)
preconditions.description: Every character in s is a lowercase English letter.

postconditions.expression: is_palindrome(result) if result != 'NA' else not any(is_palindrome(s[:i] + c + s[i:]) for i in range(len(s) + 1) for c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz')
postconditions.description: If a solution exists, result is a palindrome formed by inserting exactly one lowercase letter into s at some position; otherwise, result is 'NA'.

postconditions.expression: result == 'NA' or (len(result) == len(s) + 1 and result.replace(result[0], '', 1).replace(result[-1], '', 1) == s or any(result[:i] + result[i+1:] == s for i in range(len(result))))
postconditions.description: If result is not 'NA', it must be obtainable by inserting exactly one character into s.
